limitations.note: The agent correctly changed the counter wrap from 2 to 3, but also removed the `ready_b` guard, so the first accepted beat of a group overwrites `data_out` when downstream is not ready instead of adding to it as the reference does.

The scoreboard assumed each group starts from zero regardless of downstream readiness, so even its directed test with `ready_b` low on the first beat validated the extra change rather than checking that the original behavior was preserved.
